trailhead.label: The hamlet of Sant’Antonio, Corteno Golgi, by its church, the published start

cautions: The first part of the forest road is steep, then it levels out: let your dog set the pace.
The road is open to farm and forestry vehicles: keep your dog close and step aside for them.
The Brandet stream runs beside the road and is fast after rain or snowmelt: keep your dog out of the water.
No water point is listed on this walk: carry enough for you and your dog.
Follow local signs, lead rules and temporary closures.

emergency.note: Call the European emergency number when urgent help is required. Connectivity is not guaranteed.

textIt.Val Brandet from Sant’Antonio: Val Brandet da Sant’Antonio, andata e ritorno
textIt.The hamlet of Sant’Antonio, Corteno Golg: La frazione di Sant’Antonio, Corteno Golgi, vicino alla chiesa, la partenza indicata
textIt.The first part of the forest road is ste: Il primo tratto della strada forestale è ripido, poi spiana: lasciate che sia il cane a dettare il ritmo.
textIt.The road is open to farm and forestry ve: La strada è aperta ai mezzi agricoli e forestali: tenete il cane vicino e fatevi da parte al loro passaggio.
textIt.The Brandet stream runs beside the road: Il torrente Brandet scorre accanto alla strada ed è impetuoso dopo la pioggia o al disgelo: tenete il cane fuori dall’acqua.
